title: Driftward Plateau
description: An asymmetric faulted limestone island with a long keel, detached fragments and a grass-capped summit. The keel starts near Z=0.

review.notes: Round 2. Round-1 points: strata FIXED. There are now 5 distinct overhanging beds with crisp lips and vertical faults (closeup_base, hero.jpg), and form_detail now reaches 8. Soil rim PARTLY fixed: there is a soil band with hanging roots. Tree groups FIXED: there are 3 groves with air between them. Fragments FIXED: they are now bedded blocks that match the body. Remaining defects: (1) material: the cliff still turns bluish-grey and camouflage-mottled on the cool side (turn_245, turn_290). The summit grass in closeup.jpg is still a soft, blurry texture with large grey-brown blotches and no readable turf or tufts at the scale figure. Warm the limestone on the shaded side (ivory/ochre, not blue). Replace the blotches with grass_ground at metre scale and add tuft clusters near the figure. (2) defects: the soil rim is one smooth extruded brown ribbon of constant thickness with a clean edge, so it reads as a plastic strip. Vary its thickness (0.5-3 m), break it with eroded notches, and let grass and turf hang over it. The roots are thin uniform wires; give them taper and branching. The summit rocks sit in neat dotted rows (closeup.jpg); scatter them in irregular groups. The cliff surface repeats the same small crescent dimple stamp everywhere (closeup_base), which is the visible repetition STYLE.md lists as a defect. Vary its scale or remove it.
